title: Operate AISH runners and hosts
description: Use when operating AISH runner hosts (frota, drenar o host): install or start a runner, onboard or manage hosts (drain, suspend, reactivate, remove, legacy migration), lease and execute jobs, and submit job evidence, traces or consumption. Not for planning or approving jobs (use lpm-aish-jobs).
doneWhen: The host shows the expected state in the fleet overview, or the leased job has submitted evidence and a terminal status.
authorityCeiling: Telemetry and reads are [A]; lease, consumption, evidence submission and fleet/migration actions are [C].
jobs: start an AISH runner for project <projectId> and run one approved job
onboard a new runner host: enrollment token, wizard, doctor, start
which runners of account <accountId> are online, busy or stale, and how many hours did they work?
drain the runner host <name> before maintenance, then suspend it
migrate the legacy project runner host into the runner account
build a non-CLI runner: session, lease, trace, consumption and evidence over MCP
iniciar o runner do AISH para o projeto e executar um job
drenar o host do runner antes da manutenção
token de enrollment para o host do runner
fazer rollback da migração legada do runner
